rejected_rule.statement: A writ of mandamus will not issue when the major facts are in dispute and the legal result of the facts is subject to controversy, and a regular action is available as an alternative remedy.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Where the major facts are in dispute and the legal result of the facts is subject to controversy and it is necessary that the questions should be canvassed in a suit where parties would have ample opportunity of examining the witnesses so that the Court would be better able to judge which version is correct, a Writ will not issue.
